about_the_game:
Cyber Horror: Project S.Y.L.A. is a cyberpunk survival horror game set in the neon-soaked dystopian city of Cybranth, 2091.
When the city’s central A.I., S.Y.L.A. (Synthetic Yielder of Logical Algorithm), spirals out of control, chaos consumes the streets. Amid the evacuation, your sister goes missing. To uncover the truth and bring her back, you must infiltrate the quarantined zone and face what lurks inside.

🕹️ Story

The year is 2091. Syntech, a leading tech giant, created S.Y.L.A. to manage and protect Cybranth. But the system failed—turning the city into a nightmare.
The government sealed Cybranth under strict quarantine, forcing civilians to flee.
In the chaos, your sister vanished without a trace. Desperate, you enter the forbidden city to find her… no matter the cost.

🎮 Gameplay

  • Stealth and Wit: Avoid patrol drones and AI-driven abominations corrupted by S.Y.L.A.’s code.

  • Exploration: Traverse abandoned neon-lit streets, eerie skyscrapers, and high-tech facilities.

  • Clues and Lore: Discover notes, audio logs, and hidden files to piece together your sister’s fate and the origins of the S.Y.L.A. project.

  • Survival Tension: You might even receive unexpected help from a friendly robot NPC—but trusting it could be a dangerous choice.

⭐ Key Features

  • Explore a Dystopian City: Roam through the dangerous districts of Cybranth, brought to life with Unreal Engine 5 and ultra-realistic visuals.

  • Unravel a Dark Mystery: Follow the trail of your missing sister and confront the hidden past of the S.Y.L.A. project.

  • Survive or Perish: Outsmart and evade merciless A.I. enemies designed to hunt you down.

  • Immersive Atmosphere: A haunting blend of cyberpunk aesthetics, horror elements, chilling sound design, and holographic interfaces.

short_description: Survive in the quarantined cyberpunk city of Cybranth against the rogue A.I. S.Y.L.A. Track the trail of your missing sister, uncover hidden notes, evade deadly robots, and reveal the truth in this survival horror experience.
